about_the_game:
This classic 4X strategy game has survived for more than 25 years thanks to the devotion of dedicated fans and modders. Now you too can enjoy Emperor of the Fading Suns, renowned for its deep game play and unparalleled setting. First released in 1997, this is the Enhanced version of the game released on its 25th anniversary with significant upgrades and improvements. This demo allows you to play 20 turns, but not to save your game or use custom maps. Get the full game to:

  • Battle on land, air, sea and space as you fight for control of humanity’s known worlds as one of five Royal Houses.
  • Utilize combined arms tactics to overcome enemy positions.
  • Use a robust diplomacy engine to trade technologies, political offices, threats, favors and even votes for the imperial crown.
  • Enjoy a powerful economic engine that allows you to trade any of the dozens of resources you develop.
  • Avoid the machinations of the Church and the anger of powerful alien races.
  • Recruit legions of theurigists, psychics, mutants, warbeasts and more.

NOTE: The Steam Overlay is NOT implemented for the demo. That is part of what we are working on for the actual Steam release of the full game!

reviews:
“It was a remarkable game, and more remarkably still, its developers Holistic Design Inc. recently updated it with a major patch, 25 years after its original release.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“Emperor of the Fading Suns does something that is getting increasingly hard to accomplish: It breathes life into the stagnating and repetitive genre of space-conquest games.”
Gamespot

“Emperor of the Fading Suns radically changes the standard formula in several ways, so much so that there really isn’t anything else like it today.”
Strategy Front Gaming
short_description: This classic 4X strategy game, renowned for its deep game play and unparalleled setting, allows one to five players to battle on land, air, sea and space as they fight each other and AI for control of humanity. Trade, build, and engage in diplomacy with the Church, Merchant League, and alien races.
